name: Curse of Ineptitude
body:
School necromancy; Level bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S, M (fur of a black cat)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You impart a streak of bad luck on the target. Any actions the target takes in the round in which it is affected have a 50% chance of failing.
